The Dohkar’s voice carried across the clearing, steady as the mated-pair veilwood above us. “Speak the offering first. Then the desire.”

Seren knelt on the crimson spiralgrass, her aqua skin luminous with Weave-Script that flowed slow and open. She had rehearsed this for months.
